categories.main_business_segments: Lingda Group's primary business segments include high-efficiency crystalline silicon solar cell manufacturing through its wholly-owned subsidiary JiaYue New Energy, photovoltaic power generation via its subsidiary Geermu Shengguang New Energy, and power engineering construction services through its controlled subsidiary Tianjin Jiayue New Energy Power Engineering. The company focuses on the photovoltaic industry chain, with solar cell production historically contributing over 90% of revenue, though this segment faced production suspension in 2024. EPC engineering and photovoltaic power generation have become significant revenue contributors during the reporting period.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced PERC+SE technology for its crystalline silicon solar cells, enhancing conversion efficiency by reducing contact resistance and improving surface passivation. It plans to expand into TOPCon and HJT technologies for higher efficiency and larger wafer sizes (182mm and above). Production is highly automated with intelligent manufacturing equipment and precision testing instruments, ensuring quality and efficiency. The photovoltaic power generation segment uses high-concentration solar technology for grid-connected power stations.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Lingda primarily serves downstream photovoltaic module manufacturers domestically, with some export sales. Its photovoltaic power generation business sells electricity to the State Grid Qinghai Electric Power Company. The EPC engineering segment serves clients requiring installation, maintenance, and testing of power transmission and distribution facilities. The main customers are domestic enterprises within the photovoltaic and power sectors, with the top five customers accounting for approximately 85% of sales.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company's operations are mainly concentrated in China, with key facilities in Anhui Province (Jinzhai Economic Development Zone) and Qinghai Province (Geermu City). Sales and operations are predominantly domestic, with limited overseas sales. The registered office is in Dalian, Liaoning Province, while the main production and operational sites are in Anhui and Qinghai.
categories.supply_chain_position: Lingda operates primarily in the midstream segment of the photovoltaic supply chain, focusing on manufacturing high-efficiency solar cells. It procures silicon wafers and non-silicon materials from suppliers and sells finished solar cells to downstream module assemblers. The company also operates downstream in photovoltaic power generation and EPC engineering services, providing integrated energy solutions.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes high-efficiency solar cell technology development, focusing on PERC+SE, TOPCon, and HJT technologies to improve conversion efficiency and reduce costs. It aims to expand production capacity with a planned 10GW high-efficiency photovoltaic cell capacity. R&D efforts have been significantly reduced due to production suspension but include cost reduction and efficiency improvement projects. Lingda is also pursuing asset optimization and strategic investment to support business transformation and recovery.
categories.revenue_model: Lingda generates revenue primarily through the sale of high-efficiency crystalline silicon solar cells to downstream photovoltaic module manufacturers. It also earns income from photovoltaic power generation by selling electricity to the grid and from EPC engineering services by charging fees for power facility construction and maintenance projects. The company occasionally engages in entrusted processing where it processes materials provided by clients.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Lingda operates in a highly competitive photovoltaic industry dominated by technology-intensive and capital-intensive players. Its market position has weakened due to production suspension and financial difficulties. The company faces competition from other leading solar cell manufacturers adopting advanced technologies like TOPCon and HJT. Lingda is currently undergoing bankruptcy reorganization and aims to restore competitiveness through strategic restructuring and new investments.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Lingda's revenue sharply declined by over 92% to approximately RMB 61 million due to the suspension of solar cell production. The company reported a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 949 million, with negative net assets of approximately RMB 538 million, indicating severe financial distress. Cash flows from operations were negative, and the company is under delisting risk warnings. Lingda is in a pre-reorganization phase, actively seeking to improve its financial and operational status.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Lingda emphasizes high conversion efficiency, low degradation, and high power output in its solar cells, leveraging advanced PERC+SE technology to provide superior photovoltaic solutions. The company aims to offer cost-effective, high-performance solar cells that meet evolving market demands for larger wafer sizes and advanced cell types. Despite current operational challenges, Lingda focuses on optimizing production processes and cost control to enhance competitiveness and deliver value to downstream customers.
